definition.cost: Minimal computational overhead for search and extraction.
definition.reason: Existing evidence establishes that real-world environments involve conflicting objectives but does not yet demonstrate how an agent autonomously forms new objectives beyond its initial design. Focused collection on intrinsic motivation is necessary to address the project's core question.
definition.stop: Stop if collected literature fails to distinguish between intrinsic motivation mechanisms and pre-programmed multi-objective rewards.
definition.uncertainty: It remains unclear if current RL frameworks allow for genuine goal innovation versus optimization within an expanded multi-objective space.
